children: Unity Bancorp announced CEO James A. Hughes will retire March 31, 2027, with President George Boyan succeeding as CEO on April 1, 2027.
James A. Hughes will retire as CEO effective March 31, 2027 and will remain on the Company and Bank boards.
Boards unanimously selected President George Boyan to become Chief Executive Officer effective April 1, 2027.
Boyan will continue as President; succession follows a multi-year, deliberate planning process.
Filing emphasizes Hughes’ 26+ years of service and his role in growing assets, footprint, and shareholder value.
